description: This file defines an extension on the Process class, adding a method runAndReadToEnd(from:) that runs the process, reads all data from a specified pipe to avoid blocking due to full buffers, waits for the process to exit, and returns the data read.

classes.name: Process (extension)
classes.description: An extension of the existing Process class to add a utility method for running and reading output.

methods.name: runAndReadToEnd(from:)
methods.description: Runs the process, reads data from the specified pipe until completion to prevent blocking, waits for the process to exit, and returns the collected data.
